# Requirements Checklist: AI Sales Inquiry Triage

**Purpose**: Review that this feature's requirements-quality criteria are satisfied before planning/implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../specs/004-ai-inquiry-triage/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the requirement-quality review of the feature spec.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned artifact. Mark `[x]` only when the criterion is satisfied for requirements quality — not for implementation completeness.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied; it does not mean implementation is done.

## Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Spec fully covers the core journey: widget input -> RAG retrieval -> AI triage -> one of three dispositions.
- [x] CHK002 All three dispositions (decline, escalate, booking) are defined with distinct, testable acceptance scenarios.
- [x] CHK003 The message-extraction requirement (plain text today, structured schema future) is captured.
- [x] CHK004 System-prompt separation / data-vs-instructions boundary requirement is captured.
- [x] CHK005 Failure paths are covered: RAG unavailable, AI unavailable/timeout, bad API key, unparseable AI output, empty/oversized input.

## Clarity & Unambiguity

- [x] CHK006 Every FR is a single, unambiguous capability statement with clear MUST semantics.
- [x] CHK007 Terminology is consistent (Inquiry / Retrieved Context / Disposition / booking disposition).
- [x] CHK008 "Escalate-by-default" behavior is unambiguous across all ambiguity/failure edges.
- [x] CHK009 No placeholders, TODOs, or template filler remain in spec.md.

## Testability

- [x] CHK010 Each user story has an Independent Test that verifiably produces value on its own.
- [x] CHK011 Acceptance scenarios are written as Given/When/Then and are executable without internal knowledge.
- [x] CHK012 Success Criteria are measurable, quantitative (e.g., 100%, <60s), and technology-agnostic.
- [x] CHK013 Edge cases map to at least one requirement (no orphan edge case).

## Consistency & Constraints

- [x] CHK014 Spec honors constitution principle III (human-in-the-loop) — ambiguity and failures escalate, never guess/drop.
- [x] CHK015 Spec honors constitution principles I/V and the service-boundary (HTTP-only, independent deployable service) rules.
- [x] CHK016 User-specified deviations from the constitution (Laravel service, Groq model) are explicitly recorded in the spec.
- [x] CHK017 No hardcoded secrets; key/model/provider are configuration/env-driven requirements.

## Scope Control

- [x] CHK018 Out-of-scope items are explicitly stated (no new document pipeline, no CRM/mail escalation delivery, no dynamic booking, external structured apps are future).
- [x] CHK019 Feature does not duplicate capability that already exists elsewhere in the stack (reuses RAG service).
